From: ops@retailco.example
To: support@vendor.example
Subject: Checkout service down since 09:00

Hello,

Our checkout service has been returning 502 errors for two hours and customers cannot pay. This is the third outage this month. Please escalate and tell us when it will be fixed.

Regards,
Maria

From: procurement@cityschools.example
To: sales@laptops.example
Subject: Quotation for 500 student laptops

Dear Sales Team,

We would like a quotation for 500 laptops (8 GB RAM, 256 GB SSD) with three years of on-site support, delivered before 1 August. Please include unit price and lead time.

Kind regards,
James Okafor

From: security@bank.example
To: treasury@client.example
Subject: Unusual wire transfer attempt blocked

We blocked a wire transfer of 48,000 EUR to a new beneficiary in another country, requested from a device we have not seen before. If you did not request it, your online banking credentials may be compromised.

Bank Security Team

From: hr@company.example
To: all-staff@company.example
Subject: Team lunch on Friday

Hi everyone,

We are having a team lunch this Friday at 12:30 in the main canteen. Vegetarian options will be available. Reply if you would like to join.

Thanks,
Anna
